The '''Terr'skiar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Terr'skiar]].
